name: Morse to Text
summary: Decode International Morse code into plain text.
description: Paste dots and dashes separated by spaces, with slashes or pipes between words. Decodes letters, digits, and common punctuation using standard International Morse.

faqs.question: How do I separate words?
faqs.answer: Use a forward slash (/) or pipe (|) surrounded by spaces between words, e.g. ... --- ... / ... --- ...

faqs.question: What characters are supported?
faqs.answer: A–Z, 0–9, and common punctuation including period, comma, question mark, exclamation, slash, and at-sign.

faqs.question: Is audio Morse supported?
faqs.answer: No. Paste the dot-dash text representation only.
